cleaning_log.note: Raw rows read from the purchasing export, all as text
Category names in ALL CAPS set to standard casing
Prices like "$12,450.00" and "12,450 USD" turned into numbers
3 date columns in 3 formats parsed (0 values could not be read)
Rows with Qty of 0 or less removed
Prices over 4x the category/year median divided by 10
Kept for pricing, left out of on-time %

findings.title: Prices are up 12.4% since 2024 Q1
findings.body: Small-order unit prices moved from 100 in 2024 Q1 to 112.4 in 2026 Q2. An estimate built on a quote from 2024 Q1 will come in about 12% low, so refresh old quotes before using them.

findings.title: The big discount starts at 5-9 units
findings.body: Discount vs a 1-2 unit order goes from 2.1% at 3-4 units to 8.4% at 5-9 units (+6.3 points). If an order is just under 5 units, compare the cost of one extra unit against the savings, or combine orders across sites.

findings.title: The cheapest vendor is not the most reliable
findings.body: Allied Commercial is 11.2% under typical price but only 67.8% on time, about 17 days late when late. Harbor Restaurant Equipment is 96.6% on time at +0.9%. For critical-path items the reliable vendor may cost less overall once a delayed opening is counted.

findings.title: Plan to the p90, not the quote
findings.body: Walk-in Cooler orders are quoted at 62 days, but 1 in 10 orders takes 80 days or more (18 days past the quote). Plan to the p90, not the quote.
